:::{#lem-linearity-finite-sum}
#### Linearity of expectation for finite sums

For random variables $\dsn{X}$ with defined expectations,
and constants $a_1, \ldots, a_n$:

$$\E{\sumin a_i X_i} = \sumin a_i \E{X_i}$$

:::

::: proof

Prove this by induction on $n$,
applying [linearity of expectation](expectation.qmd#thm-linearity-expectation)
for two variables in each step.

For $n = 1$:

$$
\ba
\E{a_1 X_1}
&= \E{a_1 X_1 + 0 \cd X_1}
&& \text{(} 0 \cd X_1 = 0 \text{)} \\
&= \E{a_1 X_1 + 0 \cd X_1 + 0}
&& \text{(} v + 0 = v \text{)} \\
&= a_1 \E{X_1} + 0 \cd \E{X_1} + 0
&& \text{(linearity of expectation, } a = a_1, b = 0, c = 0 \text{)} \\
&= a_1 \E{X_1} + 0
&& \text{(} 0 \cd v = 0 \text{)} \\
&= a_1 \E{X_1}
&& \text{(} v + 0 = v \text{)}
\ea
$$

For the inductive step, assume the lemma holds for $n - 1$ variables,
and let $W \eqdef \sum_{i=1}^{n-1} a_i X_i$:

$$
\ba
\E{\sumin a_i X_i}
&= \E{W + a_n X_n}
&& \text{(split off the last term)} \\
&= \E{1 \cd W + a_n X_n}
&& \text{(} 1 \cd W = W \text{)} \\
&= \E{1 \cd W + a_n X_n + 0}
&& \text{(} v + 0 = v \text{)} \\
&= 1 \cd \E{W} + a_n \E{X_n} + 0
&& \text{(linearity of expectation, } a = 1, b = a_n, c = 0 \text{)} \\
&= \E{W} + a_n \E{X_n} + 0
&& \text{(} 1 \cd v = v \text{)} \\
&= \E{W} + a_n \E{X_n}
&& \text{(} v + 0 = v \text{)} \\
&= \sum_{i=1}^{n-1} a_i \E{X_i} + a_n \E{X_n}
&& \text{(inductive hypothesis)} \\
&= \sumin a_i \E{X_i}
&& \text{(include the last term in the sum)}
\ea
$$

:::
